ruleDefinitions.name: JXA In-memory Execution Via OSAScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible malicious execution of JXA in-memory via OSAScript

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*osascript.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*eval.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*NSData\\\.dataWithContentsOfURL.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*JavaScript.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*")))
